non_goals: Do not implement the entire Stage 0 roadmap.
Do not absorb Runner/Inspector infrastructure work.
Do not force-push or rewrite published history.
Do not delete branches merely because they are old.
Do not treat red CI as product failure without classification.
Do not create first-class Workers without user authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Paginate and classify all field remote branches and every open PR against fresh main.
Account for every unique unmerged commit before closure/deletion.
Preserve active Mobile work and Runner/Inspector infrastructure ownership.
Transplant valuable stranded work into fresh bounded domain branches from current main.
Close superseded/replaced PRs only after proof and leave concise reasons.
Delete obsolete remote branches only after their unique work is accounted for.
Record the durable Canvas, Workspace, Controls, Assets, and Mobile ownership boundaries in Runner.
Verify new branch prefixes against current automation before changing active enforcement.
Prepare first-class launch packages for Canvas, Workspace, Controls, and Assets if those owners do not already exist.
Persist a final cleanup ledger, current active-branch/PR set, and ordered Stage 0 successor queue in Runner.
Leave field/main functional and use no force-push/history rewrite.
